chapter.p: A modern English version of the Book of Mormon, authorized and published in 2024 by the Lord’s command, to be His Covenant text to guide us. This work contains the Lord’s word, truth, spirit, and power. We are entrusted to read and defend it. The original Book of Mormon was translated to be accepted as scripture by its generation, using language similar to the King James Version. However, this new version aims to help a new generation understand its content and prepare for the Lord’s return. The Divine attention and assistance in completing this new version are as significant as before. It extends an unmistakable invitation to connect with God through a renewed covenant. See also BOOK OF MORMON AS COVENANT.
